## Summary

One or two sentences. What does this PR change and why?

## Motivation

Link the issue this closes (e.g. `Closes #123`), or describe the problem.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `npm run lint` clean
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds (produces `main.js` + `manifest.json`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable
- [ ] README updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Commits signed
- [ ] **No AI-attribution trailers** (`Co-Authored-By: Claude`, `Generated-by`, etc.)

## Test plan

How did you verify this works in Obsidian? List the steps you took, the provider/model you tested against, and the observed behavior.

## Screenshots / recordings

For UI changes, include before/after.
